steps.title: Warm-up
steps.text: We always start with a general warm-up based on games, followed by stretching. It breaks the ice and gets you into the swing of things without you noticing.

steps.title: Basic footwork
steps.text: The coach teaches you the three basic movements: advance (forwards), retreat (backwards) and lunge (the attacking movement). You don't need to know them already, that is what we are here for.

steps.title: Technical and tactical work
steps.text: We do technical and tactical exercises and then directed or free bouts. The coach will most likely stay with you for a short introductory one-to-one lesson.

steps.title: Final stretching
steps.text: We finish with stretching to help prevent stiffness and injury. It matters a great deal, and your body will thank you the next day.
